jobAdApiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the job-room.ch job advertisement API used by `applyme fetch`.

applicationsDir.description: Folder applications are stored under, relative to the project root.

requestTimeoutSeconds.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds used by `applyme fetch`.

cvFileName.description: Go template for the generated cv pdf's file name, executed with the Application (e.g. "{{.CV.Personal.LastName}} {{.CV.Personal.FirstName}} - cv.pdf"). Defaults to "cv.pdf" if empty.

coverFileName.description: Go template for the generated cover letter pdf's file name, executed with the Application (e.g. "{{.CV.Personal.LastName}} {{.CV.Personal.FirstName}} - cover.pdf"). Defaults to "cover.pdf" if empty.
